'''Lem al'Dai''' is a [[Two Rivers]] man in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army. 

== Appearance ==
He is horse-faced with a gap in his teeth.

== Activities ==
Lem is among the men that accompany Perrin from the Two Rivers to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|6|45}} He accompanies Perrin into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]].{{ref/book|7|27}}
